name: Upstash QStash Free
free_limit: Upstash QStash Free: 1,000 message delivery attempts/day, 50 GB bandwidth/month, 10 active schedules and 1 MB messages
watch_out: Each delivery attempt—including retries—counts against the daily quota; one topic publish costs a delivery per subscribed endpoint. Free includes maximum 7-day delay, 3-day logs/DLQ retention and 10 concurrent deliveries; paid plans increase quotas. Do not confuse published jobs with billed delivery attempts.
